## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

- **Date:** 2026-05-23  
  **Link:** [DeepSeek API pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing)  
  **Summary:** DeepSeek’s pricing page says V4-Pro pricing will remain at one quarter of the original price after the 75% promotion ends on 2026-05-31: $0.435 per 1M cache-miss input tokens and $0.87 per 1M output tokens.  
  **Why it matters:** This materially lowers the cost floor for long-context agentic and reasoning workloads, increasing price pressure on proprietary model APIs.

  **Link:** [TechCrunch: Deep Fission IPO filing](https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/23/nuclear-startup-deep-fission-says-its-going-public-again-and-i-have-questions/)
